exposure: Clinical characteristics (preexisting chronic conditions, pregnancy-induced hypertensive disorders)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of individuals with pregnancy and postpartum hospitalizations in Hawai'i between January 2012 and September 2017.
finding: Asian, Filipino, and Native Hawaiian/Other Pacific Islander women in Hawai'i had significantly higher ICU admission rates, indicating greater severe maternal morbidity, compared to non-Hispanic White women.
